description:
Java SDK for the FlashAlpha options analytics API. Provides a live options screener
        (filter and rank by gamma exposure, VRP, greeks, and more), real-time gamma exposure
        (GEX), delta exposure (DEX), vanna exposure (VEX), charm exposure (CHEX), 0DTE
        analytics, volatility surface, implied volatility, BSM greeks, Kelly criterion
        position sizing, stock quotes, option quotes, and more. Supports Java 11+.
